reason: At ₹99 for just 100g, it is far too expensive for daily office tiffins when a standard pouch of Mother's Recipe gives double the quantity for ₹70.
objection: ₹99 for a small 100g tube is ridiculously overpriced for regular daily use—it will run out in less than a week.
would_change_my_mind: If they offer a 250g pack under ₹90 or bring the 100g price down to around ₹50.
